desc: Select a concrete compact run-length automaton DP (79 states) with backward cost table and greedy lexicographic reconstruction.

Implement `Solution.minCostGoodCaption` with a 79-state backward DP in a flat `array('i')`, using best1/best2 for switch transitions and greedy lexicographic reconstruction; run the three provided samples and report the SAMPLE TESTS verdict.
Run edge/tie tests: n=1,2,3,4,5,6, all-same strings, first-character ties, continue-vs-switch ties, and a brute-force checker for n<=8; report any mismatches.
Verify performance/memory for n=5*10^4 with one compact DP table and no full candidate strings, and re-confirm the three sample tests with an explicit SAMPLE TESTS verdict.
